modalLead: Automatic weekly backups that live safely on your server, plus two health-tools fixes.

items.text: Automatic weekly backups — nextDash now creates a full ZIP backup of your data once a week and keeps it on the server, under Config → Backup → Automatic Backups. The latest 3 are kept; when a new one is made, the oldest is removed automatically.

Download or delete any backup — each stored backup shows its date and size with a Download button to save it locally and a Delete button to remove it. A Back Up Now button creates one on demand at any time.
Countdown to the next backup — the section shows how long until the next automatic backup runs, so you always know when a fresh copy is due.
Turn it off if you prefer — a single toggle enables or disables the weekly automatic backup. It's on by default, and turning it off never affects the Back Up Now button or your existing backups.

Bulk delete removes the right bookmarks — deleting several broken links at once from the health dashboard now removes exactly the ones you selected, instead of occasionally removing a different bookmark.
Health favicons with unusual filenames load reliably — favicons whose filename contains a space or special character now display correctly in the health dashboard instead of failing to load.
